editorial:
Imagine the pain of losing your sister and having the police just give up on the case. That is exactly where you find Kath, a woman who refuses to let her sister Annie stay a mystery. The vibe here is heavy and mysterious, making you feel her desperation as she digs through old clues. When she manages to steal some secret security footage, the story takes a wild turn. You will find yourself wondering if Kath is actually discovering something supernatural or if she is just losing her grip on reality while searching for the truth.

The acting is great and really makes you care about the family drama. The way the movie builds tension is a big plus, though some might find the middle part a bit slow. If you enjoy mysteries that make you question what is real, you will love this one. You should definitely try to find it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a smart move because the visuals look amazing.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that the portal is not a magic door, but a glitch in time. Kath manages to communicate with Annie, who is trapped in a parallel version of the same spot. The twist is that Annie cannot come back to our world. Kath has to make a heartbreaking choice to let her go or stay trapped herself. She eventually finds peace, knowing her sister is safe, even if they are in different worlds.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending mysteries and family drama.
